CARIBTAP AD TERMS & CONDITIONS

Effective Date: March 10, 2026

These Ad Terms & Conditions govern the posting and display of promotional ads on the CaribTap platform.

By submitting or publishing an ad on CaribTap, you agree to these terms.

1. ELIGIBILITY
Only users on eligible CaribTap subscription plans may post ads. Ad posting availability is based on the user’s active subscription tier and the ad quota included with that plan.

2. MONTHLY AD ALLOWANCE
Professional and Premium subscriptions include a fixed number of ad postings per monthly subscription cycle. The number of ads available to a user depends on the subscription plan currently active on their account.

3. QUOTA USAGE
An ad slot is consumed when an advertisement is approved and published on the platform. Draft ads or incomplete submissions do not consume quota unless otherwise stated in the app.

4. REJECTED ADS
If an ad is rejected before publication for failing to meet CaribTap policies, the corresponding ad slot will not be consumed, or will be restored where applicable. CaribTap reserves the right to determine whether a submission qualifies for quota restoration.

5. UNUSED ALLOWANCES
Unused ad allowances do not roll over to the next billing cycle and have no cash value. Monthly ad quotas reset according to the user’s active subscription cycle.

6. AD CONTENT REQUIREMENTS
All ads must be accurate, lawful, and compliant with CaribTap policies. Ads must not contain:
- illegal products or services
- misleading or deceptive claims
- offensive, abusive, or discriminatory material
- counterfeit goods
- scams, fraudulent offers, or impersonation

7. REVIEW AND APPROVAL
All ads are subject to review before publication. CaribTap may approve, reject, request edits, pause, or remove any ad at its sole discretion.

8. AD DURATION AND VISIBILITY
Ads may run for the display period defined by the platform. CaribTap does not guarantee any specific level of impressions, visibility, clicks, enquiries, or sales unless explicitly stated.

9. REMOVAL OF ADS
CaribTap may remove ads that:
- violate platform rules
- contain false or outdated information
- generate repeated complaints
- create safety, legal, or reputational risk for the platform

10. ADVERTISER RESPONSIBILITY
Advertisers are solely responsible for the content of their ads, including pricing, descriptions, images, and claims. Advertisers must have the rights to use all text, images, logos, and trademarks included in an ad.

11. NO REFUND OR CASH VALUE
Ad allowances provided through a subscription plan are non-transferable, non-refundable, and cannot be exchanged for cash, credit, or compensation.

12. LIMITATION OF LIABILITY
CaribTap is not responsible for business outcomes arising from ad use, including low engagement, poor performance, customer disputes, or lost sales opportunities.

13. POLICY CHANGES
CaribTap may update these Ad Terms & Conditions at any time. Continued use of the ad system constitutes acceptance of the updated terms.
